purpose: Continuously reconcile Universe registry projection, readiness-release ledger and immutable Foundation release identity.
reconciliationChecks: Registry current layer matches immutable binding layer
Registry readiness release ref matches immutable binding release ref
Registry release target exists in Universe readiness release ledger
Immutable binding release exists in Universe readiness release ledger
Release ledger source layer matches binding layer
Layer-35 release identity health remains non-failing

states.aligned: Registry, release ledger and immutable binding agree.
states.degraded: Identity agrees but registry verification state or release evidence quality is degraded.
states.unknown: Required projection schema or release identity health cannot be established.
states.fail: A required registry, release-ledger or binding invariant is missing or mismatched.

mutationPolicy.rationale: Authoritative registry and release-ledger mutation requires a separate admitted control-plane operation rather than silent reconciliation writes.
